comment: The fixture s18_settings of tiaconv (TIA Portal V21, CPU 1511-1 PN): 16 retentive memory bytes from MB0, 4 S7 timers, 2 S7 counters; DataOpt with a and c retentive, DataStd (standard access) retentive as a whole, Keep_DB with n retentive (Set in IDB in Keep); maximum cycle time 200 ms, minimum 10 ms; startup Warm restart - RUN; Tod yearly from 2026-11-01 06:30; Cyc every 100 ms with a time error at 2 waiting events; HwFall on the falling edge of %I10.1. No scan_ms: the cycle is the minimum cycle time. The values are worked out by hand from the code.

steps.comment: 1 s in cycles of 10 ms (the minimum cycle time): Keep 100 times, Cyc at 100, 200, ... 1000 ms
the falling edge of %I10.1 calls HwFall; the rising edge does not
the time-of-day interrupt at 06:30 (then a year later)
values in and outside the retentive ranges (the tag KeepFlag lies at %I0.0 in the project, an input: %M0.0 instead)
power off and on: MB0..MB15, DataOpt a and c, all of DataStd and Keep_DB n kept; CycN (MW30), TodN, FallN, LoseWord lost; Warm restart - RUN
Warm restart - RUN: from STOP too the CPU starts after a power cycle
a memory reset: everything to its start values
